app.controllers.webhooks.webhook_crm: Move event persistence, sync-log creation and queueing into async services.crm_webhook_service.

app.infrastructure.cache.operatory_cache: Async Redis client; encrypted payloads and keys unchanged.

app.infrastructure.cache.sync_log_cache: Async Redis client; encrypted payloads and keys unchanged.
app.infrastructure.cache.team_member_cac: Async Redis client; encrypted payloads and keys unchanged.
app.infrastructure.cache.toroforge_billi: Async Redis client; invalidate_billing_scope is a coroutine.
app.infrastructure.database: Async asyncpg engine and sessions for the app, job-scoped worker sessions, reload_expired; sync engine kept for Alembic/tools. Readiness checks the tables and columns this code reads (REQUIRED_SCHEMA), not one exact revision.
app.infrastructure.providers.opendental: Client is built from a loaded clinic row (no session in the constructor); payload helpers called directly.
app.infrastructure.providers.payloads: Payload, time-pattern and slot helpers are plain functions; drop unused session import.
app.infrastructure.providers.toroforge.p: Classify only explicit false responses as rejected writes; read fiat payments by wallet address (getfiattransactions_address_range).
app.infrastructure.providers.toroforge.w: Classify explicit rejection conservatively; read the address's dollar transactions back from the Toronet query API.
app.infrastructure.queue: Remove the unused sync Redis client; RQ keeps its binary sync connection.
app.infrastructure.workers.appointments: Per-clinic line: a job works through one clinic's waiting events oldest first under its lock. OpenDental outages pause the line without counting; every other failure is retried five times (1 min to 6 h) and then kept in the dead queue for tools.sync_line replay; clinic problems alert the clinic at the first failure; a newer change supersedes an older one still retrying or dead. process_crm_load_job stays for jobs queued before the line.
app.models.entities: Operation journal, treasury/membership indexes, optional audit clinic and safe appointment relationships; external_operations keeps the encrypted request until it is applied. Appointments.last_event_received_at and note_hash; inbound_events sync_log_id, next_attempt_at, alert_id and a waiting-events index; registered_clinics.sync_paused_until; sync_alerts and user_notifications tables.
app.security.google: Run google-auth's blocking certificate fetch in a worker thread.
app.security.oauth2: get_current_user and validate_refresh_token use the async session.
app.security.rbac: Role lookups and access guards use the async session.
app.services.appointment_service: Async session with a lock around concurrent health commits; await caches and journal. Newer event wins (last_event_received_at); reuses a create the journal confirmed; checks OpenDental before repeating a timed-out create; ClinicProblem codes for clinic-side failures; the note is sent when it changes (note-only change sends only the note); a superseded event still sends a never-sent comm log or pop-up.
app.services.appointment_sync_log_helper: Async session; publish_change awaits the async event publisher. mark_waiting and mark_superseded: not billed, nothing counted as failed.
app.services.audit_logs: Auditlogs.log is a plain function; it only adds a row to the caller's session.
app.services.auth.login_attempts: Raise service domain errors instead of HTTPException; the key builder is a plain function.
app.services.auth.session: Async start/end of login sessions so login, refresh and logout share one module.
app.services.billing.funding_service: Async session queries, row locks and commits; await cache invalidation.
app.services.billing.kyc_service: Async session for wallet lookups and the KYC status write; return the written value instead of refreshing a partially loaded wallet.
app.services.billing.wallet_service: Async session; reload rows expired by journal rollbacks before reading them.
app.services.billing.wallet_transfer_ser: Async session; capture the transfer id before provider calls that may roll back; post balances on result=true with a TX_ID (no extra settlement field).
app.services.billing_service: Wallet-center reads use the async session and async cache.
app.services.clinic_health: OpenDental 'unreachable' health: pauses the clinic's line of CRM events with a growing wait, cleared by the next OpenDental call that works; flags outages over an hour.
app.services.dso_clinic_page_service: Async session and cache; raise service domain errors instead of HTTPException. Shows clinics whose OpenDental has not answered for over an hour, and open clinic sync alerts.
app.services.patient_creation: Async session for patient reservation and finalization; provider calls unchanged. Settles a timed-out patient create from the OpenDental search before creating again; PatientMatchError for identity problems.
app.services.registration: Own all user, DSO and clinic registration rules on the async session; bcrypt in a worker thread.
app.services.sync_log_events: Async clinic lookup and async Redis publish.
app.services.sync_log_service: Select-based queries on the async session; raise service domain errors. Label for superseded events.
app.services.team_member_service: Team listings use the async session and async cache.
